name: Alerts bell
author: Brett
description: The developer alerts bell on the banner (it used to sit on the toolbar): a bell button that opens the Alerts view and, next to it, the number of unread alerts (hidden at zero, 99+ past 99). Built from the framework's action-button and counter widgets; the alerts library (Alerts view, Settings → Alerts, delivery) stays in the framework. Show/hide and side in its settings.
